1 Total |} ==Badges== {{Badge |title = dop dop yes yes |description = skibidi |image = Dop dop yes yes badge.png |obtainable = No }} ==Official Event Trailer== [[File:Skibidi Tower Defense Simulator Episode 1 (TOILETS)|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} ToiletClean.png }} ==Trivia== *The {{Color|Deluxe|TeeVee}} [[Electroshocker]] and {{Color|Deluxe|Speaker Titan}} [[Accelerator]] were released alongside the other event skins in the [[Deluxe Crate]], and were planned limited time event skins. **However, these skins were changed to be permanent skins after a community poll. **The {{Color|Deluxe|Cameraman}} [[Gladiator]] was also an unreleased skin for '''April Fools 2024 Event''', though it was not released until after the event had ended. *The only normal [[Enemies|enemy]] in this event is the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]. *This event lasted for 8 days, which is the same as the [[Metaverse Champions Event]]. *This was the first and only April Fools edition to have its own gamemode. {{EventNavBox}}
